context: Two teens kill time after class at the bus stop
purpose: Teach: そこら/やって来/づらい/いちいち/ごとく/馴染み/飛び出し/目覚め

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわー、今日の数学マジで眠かった。先生の声、子守唄のごとく響いてさ、もう完全に眠くなるやつ。
lines.en: Ugh, math was seriously sleep-inducing today. The teacher's voice resonates like a lullaby, totally puts me to sleep.
lines.style: Casual teen complaint with self-aware classical phrasing used jokingly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。途中で意識飛んだわ。チャイムで目覚めたら涎出てて、隣の奴に笑われた。
lines.en: Totally. I blacked out mid-class. Woke up at the bell drooling and the kid next to me laughed.
lines.style: Casual teen self-deprecating story with rough masculine speech.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最悪じゃん。てか、このバス停そこら中に虫いない?さっき蜂が飛び出してきてマジ怖かった。
lines.en: That's the worst. By the way, aren't there bugs everywhere around this stop? A bee flew out at me earlier and it was terrifying.
lines.style: Teen girl shifting topic with casual filler and dramatic reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あー、この時期は出てくるよな、虫。座りづらいし、ベンチもベタベタしてるし。
lines.en: Yeah, they come out this time of year. Hard to sit down, and the bench is all sticky too.
lines.style: Casual teen agreement with multiple grumbles strung together.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ね。あとさ、お母さんがいちいち「何時に帰るの」って聞いてくるのウザい。
lines.en: Right. And my mom keeps asking me what time I'll be home every single time, it's so annoying.
lines.style: Teen girl venting about parents in informal complaining tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うちも同じ。もうお馴染みの愚痴だわ。
lines.en: Same at my place. That complaint's a classic at this point.
lines.style: Casual teen commiseration with shrug-like delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 親って全員そうなんかな。あ、ほらバスがやって来た!走るよー!
lines.en: Are all parents like that? Oh, look, the bus is coming! Let's run!
lines.style: Teen girl philosophical musing cut off by urgent excited action call.
